items.text:
I submitted my expense claim through the portal last week, and the automated tool flagged a missing receipt for the client dinner. I double-checked and found the receipt in my personal email, so I forwarded it to the assistant to attach to the claim. The assistant processed it quickly and confirmed that everything was in order.

A day later, I got an email saying the claim was approved. The assistant's summary was clear and helpful, and it even reminded me to submit the mileage form separately. I appreciate how it keeps track of these details so I don't have to.
